Senses.Explanation: The “original face” is the face a person is challenged to recognize or investigate before acquired distinctions settle the answer. The records repeatedly preserve Huineng’s question to Ming: when not thinking good and not thinking evil, “what is your original face?” (不思善不思惡，正恁麼時，如何是上座本來面目). Tianyin Yuanxiu quotes that question and the instruction to turn the light back upon one’s own original face. Guanyin Congxian deliberately removes the four words “original face” from Huineng’s demand and asks whether the alteration still belongs to Huineng’s lineage. Dahui Zonggao pairs the phrase with one’s home-ground scenery and says that the original face itself has never been deluded or awakened, locating delusion and awakening in a person’s momentary thought. Yulin Tongxiu tells the emperor to investigate the phrase in activity as well as stillness. Zhuanyu Guanheng equates the six sense-fields, when recollected without discrimination, with one’s own original face. Miyun Yuanwu urges recognition of it amid ordinary bending and looking up, then answers his own renewed question with a shout and a spatial saying. Yushan Shangsi makes his staff leap into a hall, knock down the person of no rank, and smash the original face in a deliberately extravagant hall address. Across these uses the phrase is a question, an object of investigation and recognition, an explicit equation, and a target of corrective wordplay; no single verbal reply is made its universal definition.
Senses.Note: Exact frozen-corpus count: 1,493 hits in 285 files representing 281 independent works. Seven curated occurrences from seven independent works meet the depth floor. Parallel versions of Tianyin’s record and Yulin’s exchange in later anthologies were not counted as additional evidence.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Dahui Zonggao, in the General Discourses of Chan Master Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師普說), utters the headword while distinguishing the original face from a person’s momentary delusion and awakening.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云祖言不思善不思惡正恁麼時如何是本來面目
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of National Master Puji Yulin (普濟玉琳國師語錄): Huineng is the exact actor inside Yulin Tongxiu’s nested quotation; Yulin raises Huineng’s original-face question while answering the emperor.

Occurrences.Kwic: 又則六根門頭以無分別心念佛，能念即不動智，所念之佛，六塵皆佛清淨法身，即自己本來面目。若以有分別心念佛，能念即後得智、妙觀察智；所念之佛皆六塵境耳！
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Zhuanyu Guanheng, in the Recorded Sayings of Heshang Zhuanyu Heng at Purple Bamboo Grove (紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄), utters the headword in an instruction that explicitly equates the nondiscriminated six fields with one’s own original face.
